next_step: Finish Hosted POC parity run + pricing model for Dedicated reserve
notes:
Account snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow automation). Heavy on in-app conversational help and doc search. Currently using OpenAI for generation + embeddings; looking to reduce cost and add predictable SLAs.

Recent activities (short timeline):
- 2026-01-12: Initial inbound via webinar signup; AE outreach (Samira).
- 2026-01-28: Discovery call w/ product + infra leads (10 ppl) — high level perf & cost goals.
- 2026-02-09: Hosted API demo (Samira + Diego). Went well; CTO asked about prompt parity.
- 2026-02-18: Hosted POC kickoff (2-week) — data samples, test prompts, embeddings import. Fireflies transcript ff_2026-02-18_silverquarry-hosted-demo-1.
- 2026-03-02: Mid-POC check: noticed generation style differences vs OpenAI baseline on support-agent prompts. Raised regression risk.
- 2026-03-05: SE triage session (Diego) — compatibility layer options discussed (adapter shim to map OpenAI parameters, stop-token handling, temperature scaling). Jira INF-3421 logged for evaluation bench.
- 2026-03-10: Pricing deep-dive with finance — interested in hosted for quick switch, then Dedicated reserved pool for predictable costs. Agreed to run a 1-week parity sweep with eval harness.

Use-case & requirements (concise):
- Primary workloads: chat-based support assistant (low-latency, high-availability), semantic search (embeddings), and occasional reranking jobs for search results.
- Latency targets: 95th <= 450ms for chat in US region for short-turn prompts (avg 80 tokens).
- Throughput: peak 40 qps across multi-tenant product. Batchable embedding jobs overnight.
- Model preferences: currently GPT-family for generation + text-embedding-ada-002 equivalents. Need Redwood models that match style and cost.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller model variant on Dedicated if capacity constrained.
- Data residency: US-only for customer data; retention controls for PII.

Technical concerns called out by SilverQuarry engineers:
- Prompt parity: "Our prompts have been tuned to OpenAI quirks (stop sequences + logprobs). We need parity or a reliable mapping."
- Regression monitoring: want per-prompt evals and rolling quality alerts tied to test suite.
- Compat layer: prefer minimal code changes; asked about SDK drop-in vs small adapter shim.
- Latency SLOs on Dedicated vs Hosted: need demonstrated numbers from canary.

POC plan & acceptance criteria:
- Run 7-day Hosted POC with: 100 representative prompts, embedding set (50k docs), and production traffic shadowed at 5% to call out regressions.
- Metrics to pass: generation BLEU/ROUGE-like similarity to baseline on >90% of prompts; no critical regressions on top-10 customer prompts; 95th latency within 20% of baseline for short prompts.
- If hosted POC passes, run a Dedicated sizing exercise: throughput tests (40 qps), failover/fallback exercise, and pricing/commit options.

Commercial notes:
- Price sensitivity high: procurement asked for committed monthly rate and per-token ceilings. Finance requested a sample TCO comparing current vendor vs Redwood Dedicated for 12 months.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost (quantization suggestions for Dedicated).

Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver parity sweep results by 2026-03-18 (Diego).
- Pricing deck v2 from AE by 2026-03-20 (Samira).
- SilverQuarry to provide final 100 prompt set and embedding sample by 2026-03-14.

Quote excerpts / call paraphrase:
- CTO: "We want a path to drop-in replace OpenAI without rewriting prompts — or clear mapping when necessary."
- Head of Product: "If we can hit parity and cut cost 20% we can justify a Dedicated commit."

Objections to track:
- "How different will outputs be if we switch models?"
- "How much eng time to add the compatibility shim?"
- "What guarantees for latency at scale?"

Suggested internal playbook items:
- Prepare a short doc: "OpenAI -> Redwood adapter patterns" (examples: stop-token adjustments, logprob mapping, temperature normalization).
- Run additional evals focusing on top-20 revenue-driving prompts.
- Provide a draft Dedicated sizing + pricing schedule with burst/buffer options.
